traits.naturalness: How human the streamed speech sounds for the languages the bridge declares.
traits.latency: Time from the first text segment to the first audio chunk.
traits.privacy: Confidence that the text never leaves the machine.

evidence: libs/core/streaming-tts-bridge.ts (StubStreamingTextToSpeechBridge: synthetic bytes, no real speech; eligible only when synthetic output is allowed)
libs/core/streaming-tts-bridge.ts (GeminiStreamingTextToSpeechBridge: buffers the whole prompt, cloud Gemini generate_tts)
libs/core/shell-streaming-tts-bridge.ts (operator command from KYBERION_TTS_COMMAND, e.g. piper; may be a cloud CLI, so privacy is kept low unless declared local)

naturalness.description: Meetings and conversations where the voice quality matters most.

latency.description: Turn-taking where the first audio chunk must arrive quickly.

privacy.description: Sensitive conversations: prefer bridges that keep text on the machine. Also the fallback when the default bridge cannot run the task.
